text:
7 hours ago Roanoke Rapids is staying busy in healthcare, with local hospitals and long-term care centers hiring across different shifts and skill levels.
Here are a few solid picks if you’re ready for your next move in Roanoke Rapids, NC .
Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) FT Days Employer: Signature HealthCARE of Roanoke Rapids Location: Roanoke Rapids, NC Type: Full-time, Day shift (7am–3pm) Pay: Up to $22.00/hr + $3,500 sign-on bonus Full-time CNA role in a 108-bed facility offering short-term rehab and long-term care. Day shifts, a strong benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, tuition help, uniform allowance, next-day pay), and a focus on resident-centered care make this a strong fit if you like stable hours and teamwork.
Registered Nurse (RN) PRN Employer: Signature HealthCARE of Roanoke Rapids Location: Roanoke Rapids, NC Type: PRN, 12-hour shifts (7–7) Pay: Up to $45.71/hr Flexible PRN RN role in a skilled nursing/long-term care setting, ideal if you want to pick up 12-hour shifts. You’ll provide direct nursing care, supervise CNAs/med aides, and get access to benefits like tuition reimbursement, student debt assistance (for eligible RNs), uniform allowance, PTO incentives, and next-day pay.
